choice.basis: On the dashboard's vertical color scale, pale yellow corresponds to the printed 'High' end (100) and dark burgundy to the printed 'Low' end (0). The TX polygon is filled pale yellow, the WA polygon is filled dark burgundy, and the CO polygon is filled gray. Because TX's color is at the high end and WA's is at the low end, TX has a higher displayed incidence than WA. CO's gray fill is not part of the yellow-to-burgundy gradient, so it cannot be ranked as having the highest incidence. Therefore, TX is the highest-incidence jurisdiction among the candidates.
choice.option_label: Open Texas (TX) incidence profile for follow-up routing
